Why Parents Choose VaceUp Kids

We don't just teach technology—we inspire the next generation of innovators. Every aspect of our academy is designed around your child's success and safety.

Safe Environment

Moderated classes, background-checked instructors, secure platform with parent controls.

Verified Certificates

Every child receives a blockchain-verified certificate upon completion.

Small Classes

Maximum 12 students per instructor for personalized attention.

Expert Instructors

Industry professionals with experience teaching children and teens.

Live & Interactive

Real-time classes with hands-on coding, not just videos.

Parent Dashboard

Track progress, view projects, communicate with instructors.
